findings.description: Lid wall 0.8 mm is below the FDM minimum wall of 1.2 mm unsupported (1.0 mm supported) for a 0.4 mm nozzle.
J1 top = 4.0 + 1.6 + 3.26 = 8.86 mm above the floor but the lid ceiling is at 8.5 mm: 0.36 mm interference; REQ-MECH-002 needs +0.3 mm clearance.
Cable is held only by the J3 screw terminal; a 30 N pull (REQ-MECH-004) loads J3 directly. Add a gland or clamp.
REQ-MECH-003 is worst case: 0.20 -/+ 0.25 = -0.05 to 0.45 mm, below the 0.05 mm minimum. The report skipped the worst case, and even its RSS minimum 0.02 mm fails.
Drop requirement (Verify: test) has no test in trace.json or tests/test_plan.md.
IP54 splash-proof is claimed but there is no gasket, no requirement and no test evidence.
3.4 mm hole centred 2.5 mm from the edge leaves a 0.8 mm ligament; it will crack or tear out under screw load.
